name: Odin, Ruler of Asgard
effect:
1 "Nordic Ascendant" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned. This card is always treated as an "Aesir" monster.
You can only Special Summon "Odin, Ruler of Asgard" once per turn.
You can activate "Solemn" Normal and Counter Trap Cards from your hand. Each time you activate a "Solemn" Trap Card or a "Nordic" Spell/Trap Card, draw 1 card, and gain 500 LP.
If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Solemn" Trap Card and/or 1 "Nordic Relic" Trap Card from your Deck.
